To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) we introduce a new unsupervised method for the reconstruction connectivity using calcium fluorescence, which is based on the fast combination of pairswises features; and (ii) the method is able to better eliminate the indirect links, improving the quality of the reconstructed network.
we propose a novel method that is fast, efficient, and improves the state-of the-art reconstruction of neural network connectivity using fluorescence data.

we present an efficient combination of pairswises feature networks, which outperforms the current state-of-the-art approach for reconstructing neural networks from calcium fluorescence data, and that we show that this approach is robust to noise and that the reconstruction is not biased by the choice of the features used.

the reconstruction of a network of neurons from calcium fluorescence data.
the development of a new method that is fast, accurate, and easy to use for reconstructing a neural network connectivity from calcium fluorescence data.
